name: cutoff-feasibility
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc --noEmit -p research/bapa/tsconfig.cutoff.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings research/bapa/cutoff-negative.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lint.log" 2>&1; bun test research/bapa/cutoff-negative.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; export PATH="$PWD/scripts/lean-gate:$PATH"; lean research/bapa/CutoffObstruction.lean > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lean.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'docs(bapa): record cutoff obstruction and retained proof inventory' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'runtime negative/positive controls, inventory, types, lint, standalone Lean and commitlint passed; proof searches=0' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/result.txt"
